definitions.explanation: At an unspecified time in the future.

definitions.gloss: at some point, before one knows it
definitions.explanation: At an unspecified time, often referring to the past.

examples.english: It's a movie I saw at some point.

examples.english: I want to have my own store someday.

examples.english: I remembered a story I heard at some point.

examples.english: I forgot the contents of a book I read sometime ago.

examples.english: You resemble someone I met at some point.

examples.japanese: いつか⟦どこか→どこか：02361_dokoka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れてきた→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
examples.english: A song I had heard somewhere at some point started playing.

notes:
いつか refers to an unspecified point in time. It can look either forward (someday) or backward (at some point in the past), depending on the verb tense.

FUTURE (someday):
- いつか⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きたい→行く：00119_iku⟧: I want to go to Japan someday
- いつか⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦{会|あ}いましょう→会う：00482_au⟧: let's meet again sometime
- いつか⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧: someday for sure

PAST (at some point):
- いつか⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧: a movie I saw at some point
- いつか⟦どこか→どこか：02361_dokoka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: I heard it somewhere at some point

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with ⟦{五日|いつか}→五日：28460_itsuka⟧ (the 5th day of the month). Context and pitch accent distinguish them.

WRITING:
Usually written in hiragana. Can be written {何時|いつ}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧, but this is uncommon.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- いつか: someday (unspecified, hopeful)
- ⟦そのうち→そのうち：00380_sonouchi⟧: eventually, before long (casual, suggests it will happen naturally)
- ⟦いずれ→いずれ：01789_izure⟧: eventually, someday (formal/literary)
